responsibility: This Sphinx configuration file drives the libgccjit documentation build. It selects the documentation root, output formats, themes, and exclusion rules, and it derives the rendered version and release strings from GCC source-tree metadata such as BASE-VER, DEV-PHASE, DATESTAMP, and REVISION. Its responsibility is the Python-side build configuration for generating libgccjit HTML, LaTeX, manpage, and Texinfo docs.
